name: CineCMRQCExtension
highlights: Physician-selected series can be loaded even when no source Mask exists
Series loading eligibility is determined by physician reference frames, never by Mask presence
An empty in-memory segmentation is prepared for image-only series without creating files prematurely
Physicians can mark a series as annotation-not-required, directly deleting its Mask and recording the decision history in the patient JSON
Later annotation can recreate the canonical Mask files and append the changed decision to the audit history
ED/ES confirmation is required only for series that will be saved with annotations
Whole-patient export skips image-only and annotation-not-required series
